title: Diagnostic, Therapeutic and Reproductive Aspects of Patients with Mullerian Anomalies
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to get a better understanding of the clinical implications (including reproductive problems and obstetric complications), appropriate diagnostic tools and correct surgical treatment of Mullerian anomalies.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women with a uterus
* presence of a mullerian variation
* Maximum age 45y

Exclusion Criteria:

* women without a uterus
* aged \>45y
study_population: diagnosed and/or treated in the Ghent University Hospital
